selected_model_configuration.rationale: Selected simulator operating configuration. Represents nominal operating setpoints corresponding to Rotax 914 Operators Manual Section 2.1 continuous (1.200 bar, 4572 m) and takeoff (1.350 bar) ratings, and EASA TCDS E.122 upper operating limits. This is not asserted as a universal OEM limit and does not replace TCU-specific EASA reference values. Ranges 1.185-1.215 bar and 1.335-1.365 bar represent MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_BAND (+/-15 hPa numerical simulation tolerance) around nominal targets, NOT OEM published operational limits.

turbo_system.tcu_description: Electronic Turbo Control Unit regulating wastegate servo based on throttle, RPM, ambient pressure, and airbox pressure
turbo_system.boost_control_concept: Closed-loop electromechanical wastegate positioning by TCU maintaining target manifold pressure

compressor_efficiency_map.notes: Compressor map not published in public manuals. Not fabricated.

turbine_efficiency_map.notes: Turbine map not published in public manuals. Not fabricated.

tcu_control_gains.notes: TCU PID servo gains not published in public manuals. Not fabricated.

surrogate_disclosure.notes: Exhaust manifold pressure P3 = Pamb + Delta_P_exh, turbine expansion approximately to ambient, and turbine pressure ratio are modeled quantities (MODEL_ASSUMPTION / MODEL_CALIBRATION) rather than OEM compressor/turbine-map data. Does not claim to reproduce proprietary Rotax/IHI turbocharger maps.

reduction_ratio.source: BRP-Rotax 914 Series Operators Manual Ed. 4 / Rev. 0, Section 2.1; EASA TCDS E.122
reduction_ratio.notes: Gear ratio i = 51 / 21 = 2.42857 (standard designation 2.43:1; alternative optional 2.27:1 [50:22])

propeller_speed_continuous_rpm.notes: Propeller speed at maximum continuous rating

simulator_current_representation.mode: Phase 1: 1:1 direct propeller load without reduction gear modeling; Phase 2: Integrated spur reduction gearbox (i=2.42857) with propeller load torque reflection and mechanical power conservation
simulator_current_representation.notes: Propeller speed omega_prop = omega_eng / i. Aerodynamic torque T_prop = k_prop * omega_prop^2 reflected to crankshaft as T_prop / (i * eta_gb). Power conserved: P_eng_out >= P_prop.

rpm.notes: Implemented in simulator via 1-DOF rotational ODE

propeller_rpm.notes: Currently conflated with engine RPM due to 1:1 direct drivetrain simplification

map.notes: Current simulator uses naturally aspirated density scaling; turbo boost MAP is absent

ambient_pressure.description: Static atmospheric pressure at flight altitude

ambient_temperature.notes: Implemented via ISA lapse rate and mission configuration

airbox_temperature.description: Charge-air temperature after compressor / in airbox

cht.notes: Current simulator models single lumped thermal node; does not model 4 individual cylinder heads

egt.notes: Current simulator models single empirical algebraic node with first-order thermocouple lag

egt_cyl_1_4.notes: Requires individual cylinder exhaust runner physics

oil_temperature.notes: Implemented via lumped thermal capacitance with CHT coupling and cooler dissipation

oil_pressure.notes: Implemented via speed-gain and temperature-viscosity proxy equation

fuel_flow.notes: Implemented via Willans-line affine power approximation

vibration_rms.notes: Synthesized analytically from 1x and 2x rotational orders plus broadband noise

rotax_om_914.document: BRP-Rotax 914 Series Operators Manual Ed. 4 / Rev. 0, Section 2.1

model_configuration.rationale: Selected simulator operating configuration. Represents nominal operating setpoints corresponding to Rotax 914 Operators Manual Section 2.1 continuous (1.200 bar, 4572 m) and takeoff (1.350 bar) ratings, and EASA TCDS E.122 upper operating limits. This is not asserted as a universal OEM limit and does not replace TCU-specific EASA reference values.

continuous_map_acceptance_band_bar.notes: Numerical simulation acceptance band (+/- 15 hPa) around 1.200 bar continuous target. Strictly a MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_BAND tolerance, NOT an OEM operating limit.

takeoff_map_acceptance_band_bar.notes: Numerical simulation acceptance band (+/- 15 hPa) around 1.350 bar takeoff target. Strictly a MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_BAND tolerance, NOT an OEM operating limit.

effective_lumped_cooling_thermal_capacit.notes: Effective lumped thermal capacitance of the cylinder head water jackets and head coolant volume (fast-response thermal mass ~1.2 kg equivalent). Strictly classified as MODEL_CALIBRATION; NOT the full physical 4 L cooling system inventory.

idle_intake_conductance_fraction.notes: Throttle butterfly bypass conductance fraction preventing non-physical complete intake vacuum at 0% throttle.

gearbox_efficiency.notes: Mechanical transmission efficiency of integrated spur reduction gearbox.

propeller_torque_coefficient.notes: Aerodynamic torque absorption coefficient calibrated to absorb rated power at rated propeller RPM.

bank_variation_multipliers.notes: Deterministic bank thermal variation factors (front cylinders 1, 2 receive slightly better ram air; rear cylinders 3, 4 run slightly warmer), normalized to mean 1.000.

surrogate_turbo_wastegate.notes: Coupled thermodynamic loop with TCU wastegate servo surrogate; proprietary OEM compressor and turbine efficiency maps are not public and are not fabricated.
